description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSubscriptions' that manages subscription data, including subscriber-to-topic mappings, filters, and topic data, with methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, removing subscribers, and snapshotting state.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptions
classes.description: An abstract class managing subscription data, including subscriber-topic relationships, filters, and topic data, with methods for managing subscriptions and notifying about topic changes.

methods.name: hashTopic
methods.description: Abstract method to hash a topic string into a representation of type S.

methods.name: onNewTopic
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new topic is introduced into the subscriptions.

methods.name: onRemovedTopic
methods.description: Callback invoked when a topic is removed from the subscriptions.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a stream of ActorRef subscribers for a given topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a subscriber to a set of topics with an associated filter, updating internal data structures.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from specified topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber entirely from all topics.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a subscriber is present.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an immutable snapshot of current subscription data.

methods.name: removeSubscriberForTopics
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from specific topics.

methods.name: unionSet
methods.description: Utility method to union two sets of strings.
